GeForce RTX 5070

Experience cutting-edge power with the new NVIDIA RTX 5070, built for gamers and creators who want unmatched performance without breaking the bank. As the latest addition to the RTX series, the 5070 brings advanced ray tracing, AI-driven rendering and lightning-fast frame rates. Scorptec offers a wide selection from top manufacturers for this coveted card, backed by expert advice and fast local delivery. Order your NVIDIA 5070 today or contact us for personalised recommendations.
 

Advanced performance and cutting-edge memory

The NVIDIA 5070 delivers exceptional power thanks to 6,144 CUDA cores and 12 GB of next-generation GDDR7 memory. These make it a powerhouse for 1440p gaming and demanding mainstream applications. Built for smooth gameplay and high frame rates, it handles AAA titles, streaming and creative workloads with ease. The memory bandwidth of 672 GB/s on a 192-bit interface ensures rapid data flow, reduced latency and maintained peak performance during intense gaming sessions. Harnessing the latest Blackwell architecture from NVIDIA, the RTX 5070 features upgraded Tensor and ray-tracing cores that deliver stunningly realistic lighting, reflections and shadows. The advanced processing brings immersive realism, while the enhanced cores boost performance in games and creative applications.
 

Embrace AI-driven gaming and enjoy exceptional value for money

Experience next-level gaming with DLSS 4, powered by AI, to enhance frame rates and image quality without sacrificing performance. Using advanced deep learning models, DLSS 4 intelligently upscales images, delivering crystal-clear visuals even in the most resource-intensive game titles. Combined with the 12GB GDDR7 memory, this technology ensures ultra-smooth gameplay at high resolutions. As part of the 70 segment of this series, the 5070 offers impressive performance at an irresistible price point, making it a smart choice for gamers seeking value without compromise. It provides outstanding performance in popular titles while future-proofing your system for next-gen releases. While designed for 1440p gaming, this card can also handle 4K for select titles and adjusted settings. Scorptec stocks the RTX 5070 from trusted brands, ensuring you get the best quality and performance.
 

NVIDIA RTX 5070 vs. previous generations

The NVIDIA RTX 5070 introduces significant advancements over its predecessors. The new Blackwell architecture with 6,144 CUDA cores and 12GB of GDDR7 memory are already substantial boosts hardware-wise. In contrast, the RTX 4070, based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, includes 5,888 CUDA cores and 12GB of GDDR6X memory, while the RTX 3070, utilising the Ampere architecture, comes with 5,888 CUDA cores and 8 GB of GDDR6 memory. The RTX 5070’s GDDR7 memory provides higher bandwidth compared to the GDDR6X and GDDR6, facilitating faster data processing across the board. In the software department, the 5070 supports DLSS 4, NVIDIA's latest AI-powered technology, which enhances frame rates and image quality beyond the capabilities of DLSS 3 in the 4070 and DLSS 2 in the 3070.
